name: en Inc.
summary: en Inc., established in Tokyo, Japan, in 2000, is a comprehensive human resources firm with operations extending across Japan and globally. The company's diverse service portfolio includes digital hiring solutions, talent acquisition and staffing, workforce development, human resources advisory, and advanced aptitude assessment tools. They manage a wide array of online job portals, each tailored to specific professional demographics and employment types. This includes en TENSHOKU, a general platform for career changes and recruitment; en TENSHOKU WOMAN and ONNA NO KYUJIN MART, both dedicated to supporting women professionals in their career transitions; AMBI, specifically designed for young professionals; MIDDLE NO TENSHOKU, catering to mid-career job seekers; en HAKEN for temporary employment opportunities; and en BAITO, which lists part-time and casual roles. Beyond job listings, En-japan offers a suite of complementary recruitment and HR support services. These encompass en AGENTS, providing specialized and expert recruitment assistance; en Lighthouse, an employee review and insight platform; CAREER HACK, a dedicated resource hub for professionals in the web and IT industries; and SMART GYOKAI MAP, an industry intelligence site that explores various companies and market trends. Additionally, the company delivers robust HR enablement and educational solutions. Among these are en JINJI NO MIKATA, a support platform for HR professionals; en COLLEGE, offering corporate employee education programs; engage, a digital tool designed to streamline recruitment processes; HR OnBoard, a system for identifying potential employee retention risks; and the 3E TEST, used for comprehensive talent pool assessment. En-japan also provides specialized consulting services focused on evaluation and education.
